mapper.select:
WITH SELECT DISTINCT project_id FROM ast_device WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND deleted = b'0' AND shipment_time IS NOT NULL AND sn IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(sn) <> ''
AND project_id IN #{projectId}
AND 1 = 0
UNION SELECT DISTINCT p.project_id FROM project_list_entries p JOIN ast_device d ON d.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND d.sn=p.device_sn AND d.deleted=0 WHERE p.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND p.device_sn IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.device_sn)<>''
mapper.sql:
FROM ast_device d
WHERE d.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND d.deleted = b'0' AND AND (d.shipment_time IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_list_entries p WHERE p.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND p.project_id=#{query.projectId} AND p.device_sn=d.sn)) AND d.sn IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(d.sn) <> ''
AND (d.sn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR d.product_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR d.product_model LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
mapper.select:
WITH SELECT d.id, d.sn, d.product_code, d.product_model, d.conp_version
ORDER BY d.sn, d.id LIMIT #{query.offset}, #{query.pageSize}
